evidence.observation: Reported reboiler temperature is 352.473 °C versus 87.709 °C at the next column sensor, an extreme discrepancy requiring verification.
T701 has risen to 357.647 °C while T702 is 90.255 °C and upper-column temperatures are 68.329 and 67.646 °C; the persistent discrepancy does not distinguish real overheating from measurement error.
System pressure is 599.193 mbar, pressure differences are 0.925 and 1.906 mbar, and both level switches remain at 1; these channels show no comparable sustained excursion.
